subject.title: refactor(agents): retire TOOLS.md into an AGENTS.md section with a doctor migration

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally require existing workspace owners to run `openclaw doctor --fix` to keep formerly injected `TOOLS.md` notes visible after upgrade?
rationale: The implementation is deliberately canonical and avoids a prohibited runtime compatibility reader, but it changes an existing user's effective prompt context until they take an upgrade action.

options.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
options.body: Approve retiring runtime `TOOLS.md` support, with Doctor and release-facing upgrade guidance as the supported preservation path.

options.title: Defer the retirement
options.body: Keep the current bootstrap contract until maintainers choose a different supported upgrade experience.

recommendation.title: Accept Doctor-gated migration
recommendation.body: Approve retiring runtime `TOOLS.md` support, with Doctor and release-facing upgrade guidance as the supported preservation path.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged and proposed history ties this person directly to the workspace-attestation and Doctor migration design.
